t: You're looking at Vincent Square, a large grass-covered square in Westminster. It covers 13 acres and is London's largest privately owned square, lined with mature trees including London planes. Westminster School owns it and uses it chiefly as playing fields, while the surrounding homes, hotel and organisations get a green space and a view. Nine of the adjoining buildings are protected. Sir Ivor Philipps, a Liberal Party politician who sat in the House of Commons from 1906 to 1922, died here. He had also served as an officer in the Indian Army.
